scope: EX-CPN-SCR x1 and EX-CPN-BAR x1 only; production screw/barrel remain HOLD
purpose: qualify specialist machining, Q&T, gas nitriding and final finishing route before full hot-zone parts
sequence: dimensional and roughness inspection before destructive work
engineering review before any full-part approval

matched_pair.calculation: minimum=minimum measured barrel ID - maximum measured screw flight OD; maximum=maximum measured barrel ID - minimum measured screw flight OD

hard_gates: SCM440/JIS G4105 material certificate with heat/lot ID
post-treatment screw grind and barrel final-hone route
same certified heat and same route reserved/identified for eventual production parts
responsible supplier identified across any subcontractors
traceability.hot_properties_policy: 245-270 C final-condition property data is requested when available for baseline SCM440, but absence alone does not reject P5. Any material or heat-treatment deviation requires identified high-temperature properties and engineering re-analysis before approval.
traceability.production_release: P5 PASS only permits considering a full-part quote/order; explicit user approval remains required.

evidence_policy.numeric_interval_rule: for bounded numeric requirements, measured value +/- stated U95/MPE must lie inside acceptance interval
